sentence: This project builds a sensor that uses a single chromophore on a mechanical resonator to detect changes in the magnetic field.
This project studies how heat waves, drought and soil structure affect the stress and growth of crops and how much carbon they store.
This project builds artificial intelligence models that turn limited X-ray data from mobile surgical imaging systems into three-dimensional images.
This project builds algorithms that let social robots infer a child's goals, intentions and beliefs.
This project builds a conversational tool that gives teens personalized feedback to help them act safely on social media.
This project adds robotic welding to a welding curriculum and upgrades laboratory facilities.
This project studies how different changes to the thiol group of cysteine give the sulfur atom different chemical properties.
This project explores how engineering can help study, diagnose and treat human diseases, using cells, materials, robotics and artificial intelligence.
This project tries to find out how learner-centered scaffolds shape beliefs about computational and algebraic thinking.
This project studies how wildland fire affects communities and landscapes and how they can become more resilient.
This project develops ways to defend machine learning tools used for malware analysis against attacks.
This project builds efficient zero-knowledge proofs that protect the privacy of data while showing a computation is valid.
This project tries to tell hard problems from easy ones when computers work with algebraic sets defined by polynomial equations.
This project studies how black soldier fly larvae take in and break down toxic contaminants found in landfilled organic waste.
This project improves how nuclear magnetic resonance measures small molecules by using compact atomic quantum sensors and machine learning.
This project builds biorepositories and databases to study how environmental stress affects how pathogens spread from wildlife.
This project tests whether chemicals made by diatoms harm the development and survival of Pacific herring and surf smelt embryos and larvae.
This project designs a secure learning method that lets Internet of Things devices learn from different types of data without a central server.
